messages:
deploy-bot: Kicking staged rollout v4.5.2 -> 8% to us-west-1 + eu-north-1. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Health checks: error-rate + p99 CPU for 10m. Release notes: <internal/release/4.5.2>

anna: Noted. Observing a small uptick in 429s in us-west-1 after 02m. Baseline 0.01% -> 0.3%. Could be new rate-limiter change in this version.

lee: I see the same. Thundering retries from mobile clients hitting the new burst limiter. It amplifies backend load.

carla: We rolled in a dynamic burst window to limit abusive spikes. Might be too aggressive for some SDK retry behaviors.

anna: Recommendation: PAUSE further percent increases and PIN us-west-1 to v4.5.1 while we add a temporary relaxation for SDK backoff tolerances. Avoid full rollback for eu-north if it's healthy.

oncall-bot: @lee, @carla 1: oncall is lee. Pager notified.

lee: I'll run the pause & pin now if we agree. Commands:
```
# pause rollout
deployctl rollout pause --version=4.5.2 --strategy=percent
# pin region
deployctl pin --version=4.5.1 --routes=us-west-1 --reason="429 spike from burst limiter"
```

carla: Approve. Also will open a quick patch to relax the burst window and add a runtime feature flag. ETA ~15m.

ops-bot: Reminder: pinning will route new connections to pinned version; existing long-lived connections might still hit the newer version for a brief window.

lee: Executing now. exec-20260323-320.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by lee (exec-20260323-320).

deploy-bot: Pins applied: us-west-1 -> v4.5.1.

anna: Pin confirmed. Creating incident INC-20260323-101 and assigning carla for hotfix.

carla: Hotfix PR opened: rate-limiter#77 (relax burst threshold + flag). Running unit tests then staging smoke.

lee: Monitoring us-west-1 after pin: 429s trending back to baseline. Good.

anna: Decision: STOP further ramps. Pin region to stable. Merge hotfix + smoke validate on staging before reintroducing a small 2% canary. Postmortem to include SDK retry guidance.

carla: Will update release notes and add the feature flag for a controlled rollout.

deploy-bot: Thread paused for follow-up. Reopen or @lee for GO when ready.
